## ICAN v0.1.0 — Pre-release

An infinite canvas for text, image and video creation, with custom model API templates, account sync, server-managed media and a source-built 3D Director.

### What's included

- Invitation-only registration and administrator user management.
- Private media authorization, outbound request checks and encrypted server-side configuration.
- A sandboxed 3D Director with camera setup, capture-to-canvas and scene persistence.
- Docker packaging with a non-root user, read-only root filesystem and reduced privileges.
- Removal of unused components, advertising, preset paid-provider entries and disabled HTTP interfaces. ComfyUI and RunningHub remain disabled.

### Ready-built image

**Platform: Linux / amd64.** Compilation happens on GitHub; the server only pulls and runs the image.

```sh
docker pull ghcr.io/ruoyeyu/ican@sha256:a61bbefa35ae1c3121b9fd54530591b94891d62e2347054514ba1188c419a386
```

Set `ICAN_IMAGE` in your protected operator environment file to that full digest reference. Configure the other required values before using the attached Compose file. Runtime limits are **1.6 CPUs and 1.5 GiB RAM**, without additional swap; GitHub compilation is not limited to those resources.

- Source commit and release tag target: `4702d09c590769f5ec73ef3de6b312702bcea7e3`.
- [Successful build, checks and GHCR publication](https://github.com/ruoyeyu/ICAN/actions/runs/40098999311).
- Go suite, 294 Director tests, 18 web tests, 7 deployment/publication policy tests and container/Compose/runtime checks passed.
- The image scan recorded 0 critical/high/medium/low matches and 1 UNKNOWN module match. The full original report is attached.

[Deployment, updates and rollback](https://github.com/ruoyeyu/ICAN/blob/abe9d5ed480a2c49aa5b1c252e18bac2471b4beb/docs/security/ghcr-deployment.md)

### Data and release status

Keep the existing data directory, database, media and **original `DATA_ENCRYPTION_KEY` and `JWT_SECRET`** when replacing a container. Back up data and keys separately. If a schema changes, reverting the image alone may not be enough; validate a complete restore and rollback before upgrading real data.

This is a **pre-release**. Application resource boundaries, browser session credential protection, cross-version recovery and real-server acceptance remain open. Publication does not deploy a server or approve production use. No offline image archive is included; use GHCR. The attached environment example contains no real secrets.

## 简体中文

ICAN 是用于文本、图片和视频创作的无限画布，支持自定义模型 API 模板、账号同步、服务器媒体管理和源码构建的 3D 导演台。

本版增加邀请码注册、私有素材鉴权、服务端出站检查和敏感配置加密；导演台支持机位、截图发送到画布及场景保存。移除了无用组件、广告、预置付费渠道入口及已禁用的 HTTP 接口，ComfyUI、RunningHub 保持关闭。

**镜像已在 GitHub 编译完成，服务器不需要编译。** 当前支持 Linux / amd64，拉取命令见上方。附件包含 Compose 配置、无密钥的环境示例、只读配置检查器、发布记录、原始安全证据和 SHA256 校验文件。将完整镜像 digest 填入 `ICAN_IMAGE`，配置其余必填值后再创建容器；运行限制为 CPU 1.6 核、内存 1.5 GiB。

更新必须保留原数据库、媒体、用户/API 配置及原加密密钥；先完成一致性备份和恢复验证。发生结构迁移后，不能保证只切回旧镜像就能回滚。

本版标为**预发布**：资源边界、浏览器会话凭据、跨版本恢复及服务器验收尚未全部完成。没有自动部署或修改服务器。

[中文启动、更新和回滚说明](https://github.com/ruoyeyu/ICAN/blob/abe9d5ed480a2c49aa5b1c252e18bac2471b4beb/docs/security/ghcr-deployment.zh-CN.md)
